# Meaning of Quality Trading Establishment (Sultan)

> B2B wholesale importer and distributor of industrial pneumatic fasteners, brad nails, staples, construction adhesives, PU foams, and sealants based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

## About the Organization
The Meaning of Quality Trading Establishment (مؤسسة معنى الجودة للتجارة), operating under the trade brand **Sultan (سلطان)**, was founded in 2015 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The company specializes in wholesale trading, importing, and distribution of premium industrial supplies serving furniture factories, construction contractors, workshops, and retail distributors across the Kingdom.

- **Headquarters & Central Warehouse**: Al Jazeerah District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
- **Coverage**: All regions and industrial zones across Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, Mecca, Medina, Jubail).
- **Core Brand**: Sultan (سلطان)
- **Website**: https://www.moq.com.sa
- **Contact / Sales Inquiries**: +966 59 001 9826

## Primary Product Catalogs

### 1. 18-Gauge Straight Brad Nails (F-Series)
Electro-galvanized straight brad nails engineered with a 1.9 mm slight T-head and chisel point tip for split-free precision finishing, cabinet making, trim carpentry, and joinery.
- **Wire Dimensions**: 1.00 mm × 1.25 mm (18 Gauge)
- **Collation**: 0° Straight glue-collated strip
- **Coating**: Electro-galvanized zinc plating for rust resistance
- **Tool Compatibility**: Standard 18-gauge pneumatic and cordless nailers (Bostitch, DeWalt, Makita, Metabo HPT, Paslode, Senco, etc.)
- **Sizes Available**:
  - [F10 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f10): 10 mm (3/8")
  - [F15 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f15): 15 mm (5/8")
  - [F20 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f20): 20 mm (3/4")
  - [F25 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f25): 25 mm (1")
  - [F30 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f30): 30 mm (1-3/16")
  - [F35 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f35): 35 mm (1-3/8")
  - [F40 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f40): 40 mm (1-9/16")
  - [F45 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f45): 45 mm (1-3/4")
  - [F50 Brad Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/brad-nails-f50): 50 mm (2")

### 2. Heavy-Duty Steel Concrete Nails (ST-Series)
High-carbon hardened steel nails designed for driving into masonry, brick, mortar joints, and cured concrete without bending.
- **Sizes Available**:
  - [ST18 Steel Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/steel-nails-st18): 18 mm
  - [ST25 Steel Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/steel-nails-st25): 25 mm
  - [ST32 Steel Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/steel-nails-st32): 32 mm
  - [ST38 Steel Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/steel-nails-st38): 38 mm
  - [ST50 Steel Nails](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/steel-nails-st50): 50 mm

### 3. Fine Crown Staples & U-Series Nails
Precision upholstery and cabinet staples for fabric fastening, packaging, wire mesh, and light wood assembly.
- **J-Series**: 1008J (8 mm), 1010J (10 mm), 1013J (13 mm)
- **U-Series & 80-Series**: 8006, 8008, 8010, 8012, 8014, 8016 Fine Crown Staples
- **14-Series & Heavy Staples**: 1406, 1408, 1410, 1412, 1414, 1416, 5540, 5545, 5550, 9040

### 4. Adhesives, Foams & Chemical Bonding Solutions
- **[Sultan Wood Glue](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/sultan-wood-glue-370kg)**: Premium polyvinyl acetate (PVA) wood adhesive packaged in 3.70 kg buckets (4 buckets per carton). High tensile bond strength for solid woods, MDF, and particle board.
- **[Sultan PU Foam](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/sultan-pu-foam-750ml)**: 750ml / 800g high-yield polyurethane expanding foam for acoustic/thermal gap filling, door & window frame installation.
- **[Sultan Fast Adhesive Spray](https://www.moq.com.sa/p/sultan-spray-glue-400ml)**: 400ml aerosol activator + 100g cyanoacrylate glue for instant bonding of wood, rubber, leather, and plastics in under 10 seconds.

## Commercial & B2B Purchasing Information
- **Quotations**: Custom volume pricing available upon request via official quotation list or direct sales contact.
- **Tax Compliance**: All orders receive a full ZATCA / VAT-compliant tax invoice.
- **Payment Terms**: Bank transfer and approved commercial payment arrangements.
- **Logistics & Delivery**: Prompt order dispatch from the central Riyadh warehouse to all Saudi cities and industrial zones.
